Research Engineer with a background spanning materials science, mechanical
systems, and applied machine learning. I hold an MS in Materials Science and
Engineering from Louisiana State University and a BS in Mechanical
Engineering from Southeastern Louisiana University, and I've spent my career
at the intersection of experimental design, materials characterization, and
the software that makes test data actually usable.

Outside of my day-to-day work, I'm teaching myself machine learning through
independent projects — mostly time-series anomaly detection and computer
vision applied to problems I find genuinely interesting, from industrial
predictive maintenance to surgical video analysis.

## Experience

**Research Engineer III** — ConMed Advanced Surgical *(Nov 2021 – Oct 2025)*
Led experimental design and execution for new surgical technologies,
including hydrophobic coating development for electrodes. Owned test
protocols and Design History File documentation under a formal Quality
Management System, and built a Python-based topic-modeling tool to turn
open-ended Voice-of-Customer survey data into structured design inputs.

**Mechanical Design Engineer & R&D Specialist** — Benoit Premium Threading
*(Nov 2019 – Nov 2021)*
Designed and executed corrosion and coating studies for oil and gas tubular
goods, and used FEA (COMSOL) to predict material failure during plastic
deformation.

## Education

**MS, Materials Science and Engineering** — Louisiana State University, 2018
Research assistant modeling pool boiling via level-set methods; fabricated
super-hydrophobic substrates for condensation experiments using thermal
imprinting and self-assembly monolayers. Taught heat treatment, alloy
hardening, and SEM concepts as a teaching assistant.

**BS, Mechanical Engineering** — Southeastern Louisiana University, 2014
